plain: I'm lending you my camera for the weekend.
legal: The Owner hereby lends the Camera to the Borrower for the duration of the weekend.

plain: Bring it back by Monday morning.
legal: The Borrower shall return the Camera no later than Monday morning.

plain: If you break it, you pay for the repair.
legal: The Borrower shall bear the cost of repairing any damage to the Camera.

plain: You can borrow my car, but don't let anyone else drive it.
legal: The Borrower may use the Vehicle, provided that no other person shall drive it.

plain: Fill up the tank before you return the car.
legal: The Borrower shall refuel the Vehicle before returning it.

plain: We split the rent 50/50.
legal: The rent shall be shared between the Roommates on an equal (50/50) basis.

plain: Each of us pays our own phone bill.
legal: Each Roommate shall pay for the Roommate's own telephone services.

plain: Utilities are split three ways.
legal: Utility charges shall be divided equally among the three (3) Roommates.

plain: Whoever cooks doesn't have to do the dishes.
legal: The Roommate who prepares a meal shall not be required to wash the dishes.

plain: Overnight guests are fine, but no more than 2 nights a week.
legal: Overnight guests shall be permitted for no more than two (2) nights per week.

plain: Quiet after 11 pm on weeknights.
legal: Quiet shall be observed after 11 pm on weeknights.

plain: Take the trash out on Tuesdays and Fridays.
legal: Refuse shall be taken out on Tuesdays and Fridays.

plain: If you move out, give the others a month's notice.
legal: Any Roommate who intends to move out shall give the other Roommates one (1) month's notice.

plain: You'll find someone to take your room if you leave early.
legal: A departing Roommate shall find a replacement occupant if the Roommate leaves before the end of the term.

plain: I'll feed your cat twice a day while you're away.
legal: The Sitter shall feed the Cat twice daily during the Owner's absence.

plain: I'll water the plants every 3 days.
legal: The Sitter shall water the plants every three (3) days.

plain: You'll pay me $25 per day for pet sitting.
legal: The Owner shall pay the Sitter $25 per day for pet-sitting services.

plain: If the cat gets sick, I'll take her to the vet and you'll pay the bill.
legal: If the Cat becomes ill, the Sitter shall take the Cat to a veterinarian, and the Owner shall pay the resulting fees.

plain: I'm paying you back the $400 I owe you by the end of the month.
legal: The Debtor shall repay the sum of $400 to the Creditor by the end of the month.

plain: I'll pay you $100 a week until the loan is paid off.
legal: The Borrower shall repay the loan in weekly installments of $100 until it has been repaid in full.

plain: There's no interest on this loan.
legal: No interest shall accrue on the loan.

plain: We'll take turns driving to work each week.
legal: The Parties shall alternate driving duties on a weekly basis.

plain: Passengers chip in $10 a week for gas.
legal: Each passenger shall contribute $10 per week toward fuel costs.

plain: If you can't make it, text the driver by 7 am.
legal: Any passenger who is unable to travel shall notify the driver by text message no later than 7 am.

plain: You can use the garage to store your boxes until June.
legal: The Owner permits the Licensee to store boxes in the Garage until June.

plain: I'm not responsible if your stuff gets damaged in the garage.
legal: The Owner shall not be liable for any damage to the Licensee's property stored in the Garage.

plain: The babysitter will watch the kids from 6 pm to 11 pm on Saturday.
legal: The Babysitter shall care for the Children from 6 pm to 11 pm on Saturday.

plain: No screens after 8 pm.
legal: The Children shall not use electronic screens after 8 pm.

plain: Call us right away if there's an emergency.
legal: The Babysitter shall contact the Parents immediately in the event of an emergency.

plain: I'll mow your lawn every Saturday for $30.
legal: The Contractor shall mow the Owner's lawn every Saturday for a fee of $30.

plain: You can keep the bike if you pay me $150 by Friday.
legal: The Buyer may retain the Bicycle upon payment of $150 to the Seller by Friday.

plain: The bike is sold as is.
legal: The Bicycle is sold in its present condition.

plain: The tickets are mine, but you can use one if you pay half.
legal: The Tickets belong to the Purchaser, who permits the other Party to use one (1) Ticket upon payment of half of the total price.

plain: Each family brings one dish to the picnic.
legal: Each family shall contribute one (1) dish to the picnic.

plain: I'll look after your mail and forward anything important.
legal: The Caretaker shall collect the Owner's mail and forward any item of importance.

plain: We share the cost of the fence equally.
legal: The Neighbors shall bear the cost of the fence in equal shares.

plain: The fence will be built along the existing boundary line.
legal: The fence shall be erected along the existing boundary line.

plain: Each of us maintains our own side of the fence.
legal: Each Neighbor shall maintain the side of the fence facing the Neighbor's own property.

plain: Trim the tree branches that hang over my yard.
legal: The Neighbor shall trim any branches overhanging the adjoining property.

plain: The band rehearses in my basement on Thursday nights.
legal: The Band shall be permitted to rehearse in the Owner's basement on Thursday evenings.

plain: Rehearsals end by 10 pm.
legal: Rehearsals shall conclude no later than 10 pm.

plain: The book club meets on the first Sunday of every month.
legal: The Book Club shall meet on the first (1st) Sunday of each month.

plain: Whoever hosts picks the book.
legal: The host of each meeting shall select the book.

plain: You can stay in my apartment for free while I'm abroad.
legal: The Owner permits the Occupant to reside in the Apartment free of charge during the Owner's absence abroad.

plain: You'll pay the electricity while you stay there.
legal: The Occupant shall pay the electricity charges for the duration of the stay.

plain: The prize money will be split evenly among the team.
legal: The prize money shall be divided equally among the members of the Team.

plain: We'll buy the gift together and each pay a third.
legal: The Parties shall purchase the gift jointly, with each Party contributing one third of the cost.

plain: You can use my Netflix account, but don't change the password.
legal: The User may access the Owner's streaming account but shall not change the password.

plain: The tent and gear belong to Sam; everyone else can use them.
legal: The tent and equipment are the property of Sam and may be used by the other members of the group.

plain: Return the ladder when you're done.
legal: The Borrower shall return the ladder upon completion of its use.

plain: The deposit for the cabin is non-refundable after May 1.
legal: The deposit for the Cabin shall be non-refundable after May 1.

plain: I'll cover your shift on Friday if you cover mine next Tuesday.
legal: The first Employee shall work the second Employee's shift on Friday in exchange for the second Employee working the first Employee's shift on the following Tuesday.

plain: You can sublet my parking spot for $60 a month.
legal: The Holder may sublet the parking space to the Subtenant for $60 per month.

plain: Payment for the spot is due on the 1st.
legal: Payment for the parking space shall be due on the first (1st) day of each month.

plain: No one may bring glass bottles to the beach party.
legal: Glass bottles are prohibited at the beach party.

plain: Everyone cleans up their own area before leaving.
legal: Each attendee shall clean the attendee's own area prior to departure.

plain: We'll sell the old sofa and split the money.
legal: The Parties shall sell the old sofa and divide the proceeds equally.

plain: If no one buys the sofa in 2 weeks, we'll donate it.
legal: If the sofa remains unsold after two (2) weeks, the Parties shall donate it.

plain: I'll drive the kids to school on Mondays and Wednesdays.
legal: The first Parent shall drive the Children to school on Mondays and Wednesdays.

plain: Changes to the schedule need a day's notice.
legal: Any change to the schedule shall require one (1) day's notice.
